$description: Capsomer tokens. Generated by tokens/scale.mjs; the CSS files are the contract. type and control show the compact density; density-compact and density-comfortable hold both sets.

space-1.$description: hairline gaps: an icon beside its count

space-1-5.$description: half a step: a hairline nudge (a chevron's margin, a control's padding less its edge)

space-2.$description: inside a control: icon to label

space-2-5.$description: half a step: the gap in a chip, a segmented control or a toolbar's tight group

space-3-5.$description: half a step: a compact panel's inner gap

space-4.$description: between rows of a form, cell padding

space-5.$description: panel padding, the page gutter on a phone

space-8.$description: between major regions of a reading page

radius-xs.$description: a mark inside text: a highlight, a lamp, a drag handle

fs-label.$description: column labels and section titles, uppercase; nothing is set smaller

fs-detail.$description: the line under a row title

fs-h2.$description: a page title in the app

fs-prose.$description: body text in the reading context

fs-prose-h2.$description: a heading in the reading context

fs-input-coarse.$description: a form input on a touch screen, so iOS does not zoom (never under 16px, whatever the default size)

prose.$value: "Source Serif 4", "Source Serif 4 Fallback", "Iowan Old Style", Charter, Georgia, serif

display.$description: a heading that wants a display face (the page head's title, an app's own headings): Inter, at its text cut (the display cut cost dustinedwards.info /systems its 2.5 s LCP, Dustin 2026-11-05); a site may set its own

weight-title.$description: a page title or a name set at 24px and up: Inter Light, NASA NHB 1430.2's Helvetica Light (section 5.2); never under 24px, where Light thins out

weight-heading.$description: a heading inside a page: Inter Medium, the manual's Helvetica Medium

fs-tiny.$description: a count badge's digits or a mark's letter; never running text

fs-small.$description: small print at a fixed size: a caption, a footnote, a chart's label

mono-size.$description: an identifier's size (.cap-mono): a site with a denser body may set its own

text-strong.$description: the strong text role's weight (.cap-text data-weight="strong")

title-1.$description: the largest title role (.cap-title data-size="1"): a page's one title

title-display.$description: a standalone page's one title, fluid from 32 to 48px: a reading page's title band, a missing page's poster

title-2.$description: title role 2: a page title on a quieter page

title-4.$description: title role 4: a subsection or a card's title

title-5.$description: title role 5: a small card or list title

title-6.$description: title role 6, the smallest: a title at the body size

wayfinding.$description: wayfinding links only (breadcrumbs, footer links, next and back): Overpass, the free Highway Gothic of FAA airport signs (AC 150/5345-44L, Appendix A), at 700 (600 in the footer)

poster.$description: a standalone piece with lettering (a share card, a title image, a banner, a flyer, a 404 title): Jost, the free Futura (NASA NHB 1430.2 section 5.4); never text under an Inter heading

drafting.$value: "Capsomer Drafting", "Capsomer Drafting Fallback", "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif
drafting.$description: labels in a line drawing or plate and words on a lit panel: Leroy lettering, in capitals (ASME Y14.2 4.3) with lowercase only for units and gene names

readout.$description: a lit instrument number (a reading, a stat on a panel): the Apollo DSKY's seven segments, upright 400; a countdown or elapsed time takes the same family in italic 300, the KSC press-site clock; digits, minus, colon and period only

dur-fast.$description: feedback (hover, press) and every exit: what leaves goes faster than it came

dur-base.$description: an overlay or a page arriving

dur-slow.$description: a spring settling (with --ease-spring); a page-level change

dur-pulse.$description: one breath of a resting pulse or sweep (a skeleton, a meter's indeterminate bar)

dur-flow.$description: one cycle of a slow ambient loop (a flow along a map's line, a sample's glow)

dur-wait.$description: one cycle of a loading line or pulse, drawn only while something is actually in flight

ease-out.$description: things arriving and leaving: a fast start and a long soft stop (Radix Themes, Arc)

ease-spring.$description: a release or a thumb settling: a damped spring, 95% at 30% of the time, 4% past; transform only, with --dur-slow

weight-light.$description: Inter Light: a title at 24px and up (--weight-title)

weight-medium.$description: a label, a heading inside a page (--weight-heading)

weight-semibold.$description: strong text, a link, a button (--text-strong, --link-weight)

weight-bold.$description: a mono label in capitals, wayfinding (Overpass at 700)

weight-heavy.$description: a glyph drawn as a mark (a required asterisk, a drop zone's plus)

leading-none.$description: one line in a box sized by its own height: a badge, an icon's label, a big figure

leading-tight.$description: a title of two or more lines

leading-snug.$description: a row title, a card's heading, a label over a field

leading-compact.$description: a dense row's detail line, a menu item

leading-normal.$description: app body text (--leading in both densities)

leading-relaxed.$description: reading text (--leading in the reading context)

leading-loose.$description: a mono list or a small caption that needs air between its lines

tracking-wide.$description: small text in capitals that is read, not scanned

tracking-caps.$description: a small label in capitals (an eyebrow, a column head)

tracking-sign.$description: lettering on a sign or a stencil

opacity-ghost.$description: a mark behind content, seen only as texture

opacity-faint.$description: a placeholder or a mark at rest that the pointer brings forward

opacity-half.$description: half seen: a control that cannot be used now (never the only cue), a mark in the background

opacity-muted.$description: a secondary mark or a struck-out choice

opacity-soft.$description: a surface that lets a hint of the page show through

z-raise.$description: a part raised above its own card (a stretched link's actions); local stacking only

z-sticky.$description: a sticky top bar or anchor bar

z-overlay.$description: a scrim and a side panel

z-progress.$description: the page's loading bar, over everything but the skip link

z-skip.$description: the skip link, which must clear every bar it jumps past

line-w.$description: a hairline: a rule, a box's edge, a table's row line

line-w-mid.$description: a drawn mark's stroke: a chevron, a breadcrumb's divider, a checkbox's tick

line-w-thick.$description: a heavy rule: a part title's line, a selected tab's bar

line-w-bar.$description: the side bar that marks the current, chosen or failing item in a list

line-w-heavy.$description: a callout's side rule, a section's top rule

line-w-band.$description: a sign's color band (the manual's stripe, the footer's top band)

radius-control.$description: a control's corners (button, field, select); a square site sets 0 in its SITES entry

focus-width.$description: the focus outline, WCAG 2.4.13's 2 px perimeter; its color is --ring, checked at 3:1 by palette.mjs

focus-offset.$description: space between the control and its ring

focus-offset-tight.$description: a ring drawn close: on a control in a dense row, or inset by it on a tile

ring-width.$description: the soft glow around a focused field (shadcn's ring-3); the 2 px outline stays the focus indicator

measure.$description: a reading line: WCAG 1.4.8's 80-character ceiling, about two-thirds of the family page's column at the 17px body (Dustin, 2026-10-28: the 66-character line was too narrow on the wider page)

page-max.$description: the family page width, gutters included (a 1408px column): every site's letterhead, content and footer line up on it (.cap-page). Running text keeps --measure inside it; grids, maps and tables use the rest (Dustin, 2026-10-28: "it can be wider")

fs-page.$description: the family page's body text (.cap-page), the same on every site; an app's rows keep --fs-body

page-gutter.$description: the page's side margin inside --page-max, and the least margin at any width

rail-w-collapsed.$description: the shell's left menu, collapsed to icons

figures.$description: a number on its own (a count, a tile's figure, a percent, a time): Inter's tabular set keeps the comma and period narrow (0.269 em), so a tile's figures hold their width as they change without a gap at the comma

figures-column.$description: numbers down a column (a table's data-num cells, .cap-num), where the digits must line up and a wide comma lines up too

faa-arrow.$description: the wayfinding arrow, an FAA airport sign's (AC 150/5345-44L, Fig. A-5): a clip path for a box 1em wide and 0.72em tall, whose shaft is 0.125em, Overpass Bold's stem, as Note 1 sets the shaft to the legend's stroke, and a triangular head; drawn in the text's color (a currentColor background), since Overpass has no arrows. A clip path, not a data: image, so a strict Content-Security-Policy (img-src 'self') never blocks it

faa-arrow-out.$description: the footer's outbound arrow, the FAA arrow's thick shaft and head as a clip path, turned 45 degrees up and right

header-h.$description: the site header, 56px on every site and surface (docs/design/design-site-header.md, answer 6)

cap-arrow.$description: the family arrow's shape, a clip path (css/base.css): a token so a page without base.css, such as the Portal, still draws the header's arrows

link-weight.$description: a text link's weight; "inherit" draws it at the text's own weight

link-decoration.$description: a text link's line at rest, hover and focus; "underline" for a site that wants one

link-hover-decoration.$description: a text link's line under the pointer; "underline" for a site that shows one on hover (a site with a line at rest sets both)

link-offset.$description: how far a text link's line sits below the text, when it has one

link-hover-bg.$description: the tint under the pointer; "transparent" for none

link-pressed-bg.$description: the tint while pressed; "transparent" for none

link-tint-pad.$description: how far the tint reaches past the text, in a shadow of the tint's color; 0px for none

link-rule.$description: the site header's section links: an underline that grows in under the pointer; 0 draws none

icon-radius.$description: the site header's icon controls and the theme button (--radius-m; 999px for a circle)

icon-border.$description: their outline's width, in the band's line

theme-turn.$description: the theme button turns this far under the pointer

arrow-rest.$description: a .cap-arrow's opacity at rest; 0 lets it slide in under the pointer

arrow-shift.$description: how far back a .cap-arrow sits at rest

card-lift.$description: how far a linked panel (a.cap-panel) rises under the pointer; a negative length lifts it

card-edge.$description: a linked panel's edge under the pointer: 0 the strong line, 1 the accent, between them a mix

btn-sweep.$description: the default button fills with the primary color from the left under the pointer: 0 off, 1 on

bp-sm.$description: a phone ends: one column becomes two, a tray becomes a sidebar

bp-md.$description: a tablet: the site header shows its links, a rail appears

bp-lg.$description: a desktop: the reading column gets its side rail

bp-xl.$description: a wide desktop: the page reaches its widest grid

control.$description: a control's height with a fine pointer (one step above the Portal's 32; shadcn vega's h-9)

control-h-coarse.$description: a control's height with a coarse pointer

control.$description: a control's height with a fine pointer (one step above the Portal's 32; shadcn vega's h-9)

pad-y.$description: a control's block padding where it is not a fixed height (a textarea, a menu item)

pad-card.$description: a card or panel's padding (shadcn's card spacing, nova 16 and vega 24)

fs-label.$description: column labels and section titles, uppercase; nothing is set smaller

fs-detail.$description: the line under a row title

gap.$description: between rows of a form and between sibling blocks

row-h.$description: the least height of a list or table row
